description: This file defines a Tooltip class for Bootstrap v2.0.4, implementing tooltip functionality with methods for showing, hiding, positioning, and configuring tooltips, along with plugin registration.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: A class implementing tooltip behavior for Bootstrap, including methods for initialization, content setting, positioning, showing, hiding, and enabling/disabling tooltips.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the tooltip with specified type, element, and options, setting up event handlers based on trigger type.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Merges default options with user-provided options and data attributes, handling delay configuration.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles mouseenter or focus events to show the tooltip after a delay if configured.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Handles mouseleave or blur events to hide the tooltip after a delay if configured.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the tooltip, positioning it based on placement options and content.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides and removes the tooltip, with optional transition animation.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the tooltip content based on the title attribute or function.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip title from data attributes or options.

methods.name: tip
methods.description: Returns the tooltip DOM element, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: fixTitle
methods.description: Removes the title attribute from the element to prevent default browser tooltips.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if the tooltip has content to display.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of the element for tooltip placement.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the element is still in the DOM and hides tooltip if not.

methods.name: toggleEnabled
methods.description: Toggles the enabled state of the tooltip.
